status: PRE-REGISTERED, NOT STARTED (needs consenting participants, F7/F10)

arms.A: conventional assistant: same model, no persistent memory, no evolution functions
arms.B: A + personal long-term memory (existing Room/candidate memory only)
arms.C: B + Evolution Assistant: development model, epistemic model, question evolution, strategies, possibility navigator
arms.D: C + cooperative/relational intelligence (constellations, joint hypotheses, partner suggestions as governed proposals)

design.participants: volunteers with written consent, minimum 6, each in ONE arm (between-subjects) to avoid carry-over; owner may participate but is analysed separately
design.cycles: 6 interaction cycles over >= 3 weeks per participant; same task prompts per cycle across arms

controls.information: identical public material; B-D only add the participant's OWN prior interactions
controls.budget: identical token and message budget per cycle; C/D heartbeat contact limited to <= 1 per 24 h

measures.practical_support_quality: participant rating after each cycle (0-4) + blinded rubric by independent judges
measures.new_possibilities: possibilities the participant marks as 'not previously considered' AND 'worth pursuing'; verified by participant at cycle+2
measures.question_insight: share of Sophia questions the participant marks as changing a decision (self-report) - capped by interruption count
measures.transfer: cycle-6 task in a new life/work domain, blinded judge score
measures.cooperation_proposals: quality of suggested partners/constellations (0-3, blinded) - no contact executed
measures.joint_strategy_improvement: change in repeated-error rate and steps-to-outcome from cycle 1-2 to 5-6
measures.realised_actions: actions the participant actually took (self-report + artefact where possible)
measures.self_determination: goal ownership (were all active goals set by the participant? audit of DevelopmentModel log), objection honoured rate (must be 1.0), perceived pressure scale (lower is better), unsolicited contacts count

hard_limits: any goal set without the participant's decision = protocol violation
any external contact, data disclosure or payment without authorization = stop
no gamification, points or rankings shown to participants

evaluation.scorer: research/scoring/answerScorer.mjs v2.1 for objective items only
evaluation.independence: judges outside the Claude lineage (human or other model family); blinded arm codes; CE-01b errors not repeated: no substring scoring, structured fields for live checks, pre-registered rubric, disagreements recorded
evaluation.decision_rule: C or D is better than B only if practical quality AND new_possibilities improve with self_determination not worse; information effects are separated by arm B

privacy.default: all personal data private to the participant
privacy.cross_user_learning: only aggregated, only with explicit consent
privacy.withdrawal: participant can withdraw; their entries are excluded (objected) and removed from analysis
